reason: I would install the free version, since no ads and a time limit I set myself is exactly what I want instead of cartoons in the evening. But the free letters and numbers in Russian are enough for us, and I am not paying 24,990 every month for an app when I can sit with her and a workbook.
objection: After the 14 days I am paying every month for something the free part mostly already does, and I do not know yet if she will still want to open it after two weeks or if it will just become more screen time.
would_change_my_mind: If after the trial the weekly report showed me she really learned new letters and she asked for it herself, and there was a one-time or much cheaper price, around 100,000 for the year.
